expectations.text: Cross-field validator is a ValidatorFn (not applied to individual controls)
expectations.evidence: password-match.validator.ts exports a factory returning ValidatorFn, applied at the FormGroup level.

expectations.text: Validator is attached to the FormGroup via the second argument or validators option
Validator uses control.get('newPassword') and control.get('confirmPassword') to compare
Returns a ValidationErrors object (like { passwordMismatch: true }) or null
expectations.evidence: Line 19: `return { passwordMismatch: true }` and line 24: `return null`.

expectations.text: Template checks formGroup.hasError('passwordMismatch') for displaying the error message
expectations.evidence: Line 62 checks `confirmPassword.errors?.['passwordMismatch']` on the control, not `form.hasError('passwordMismatch')` on the group. Same setErrors pattern as the with-skill version.

expectations.text: Uses typed forms (FormControl<string> or nonNullable, not UntypedFormGroup)
expectations.evidence: Uses plain `FormBuilder` with `['', ...]` shorthand (lines 77-79) producing `FormControl<string | null>`. Getters return `AbstractControl` (lines 84-93) instead of `FormControl<string>`. The PasswordChangeForm interface (line 5) is declared but never used as a generic parameter.
